material.description: blocked_by: gap-mod-unit-id-mapping. Remote main facts (ref=main, tip cb054d35). (1) mod-host lib.rs ~707-716: game.cmd_spawn pushes Cmd::Spawn{index: catalog index, x, y} with no unit id; the Lua call returns nothing, so the mod never learns an id. (2) mod-host lib.rs ~301-316: host spawn_unit spawns directly into the mod world and discards Sim::spawn's Option<usize> (sim/src/arrays.rs:521); it does not queue Cmd::Spawn. (3) mod-host lib.rs ~1045-1046 apply_commands spawns into the mod world and discards the index; it only runs for commands queued by systems (tick order: run_systems, apply_commands, fire_timers, run_on_tick), so on_tick cmd_spawn commands are never applied to the mod world and go straight to the room via take_commands (lib.rs ~1171, mods.rs ~94). (4) room.rs ~247-248 discards sim.spawn's index. Consequence: no mod-world index exists at queue time on the queued path, and a mod that spawns via cmd_spawn has no id to order. The decided carry-the-index design needs another id source (e.g. a mod-side monotonic handle returned by cmd_spawn, keyed in the room map). That is a design change beyond the one-field scope; orchestrator decision needed.
material.subject: Cmd::Spawn cannot carry a mod-world index: the index does not exist when the command is queued
material.witness: Closed by probe: served room with mod game.cmd_spawn emits ev=mod_unit_bound handle=1 unit=30 (room.rs:342-345); mod reads its unit id from ModUnitBound, no new channel. Witness line in .gm/witness-log.md.
